about: Shipped advisories ecodex accepts until upstream codex moves the dependency (scripts/scoped_cargo_audit.py). Each needs a semver-major bump in an upstream crate; re-check at every upstream sync and remove an entry once the audit no longer reports it (a stale entry fails the gate).

accepted.reason: DNSSEC: a parent-side NSEC record at a zone cut is accepted as proof of nonexistence. Fix lands only in hickory-proto >=0.26.0-beta.1 (no 0.25.x patch); ecodex has 0.25.2 through hickory-resolver 0.25 <- rama-dns <- upstream codex's rama stack, which neither manifest pins and which a semver-compatible cargo update cannot move (a 0.25->0.26 major bump is upstream's call). Not reachable: ecodex is not a validating resolver — hickory answers the HTTP client's forward (A/AAAA) lookups against the configured stub resolvers, and transport security rests on TLS certificate validation of the HTTPS endpoint, not on a DNSSEC nonexistence proof.

DNSSEC: a child-side NSEC/NSEC3 record is accepted as proof that a delegation has no DS record. Fixed only in >=0.26.0-beta.1; same dependency path and non-reachability as RUSTSEC-2026-0530 (ecodex performs no DNSSEC validation).
DNSSEC: a parent-side NSEC3 record at a zone cut is accepted as proof of nonexistence. Fixed only in >=0.26.0-beta.1; same dependency path and non-reachability as RUSTSEC-2026-0530.

DNSSEC: an NSEC3 NODATA response at a zone apex is accepted without an NSEC3 record matching the query name. Fixed only in >=0.26.0-beta.1; same dependency path and non-reachability as RUSTSEC-2026-0530.
DNSSEC: an unsigned NSEC or NSEC3 record is used in a nonexistence proof. Fixed only in >=0.26.0-beta.1; same dependency path and non-reachability as RUSTSEC-2026-0530.
DNSSEC: records with a DNS class other than the query's are marked secure without being validated. Fixed only in >=0.26.0-beta.1; same dependency path and non-reachability as RUSTSEC-2026-0530.
